sources.snippet: AMD Instinct MI300X Overview The AMD Instinct MI300X is the CDNA 3 accelerator that made AMD a serious LLM inference vendor: 192 GB of HBM3 at 5.3 TB/s, more than double H100 memory, with 2,615 dense FP8 TFLOP/s. Eight chips connect in a full-mesh Infinity Fabric node with no switches, 448 GB/s of scale-up bandwidth per chip.
